name: teaching-platform
description: 本地开发：根目录 npm 一键起前后端；数据库/Redis 见 RUN.txt

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix api-gateway && npm install --prefix course-service && npm install --prefix homework-grade-service && npm install --prefix lab-practice-service && npm install --prefix judge-worker
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix api-gateway && npm run build --prefix course-service && npm run build --prefix homework-grade-service && npm run build --prefix lab-practice-service && npm run build --prefix judge-worker
scripts.test:services: npm test --prefix api-gateway && npm test --prefix course-service && npm test --prefix homework-grade-service && npm test --prefix lab-practice-service && npm test --prefix judge-worker
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:dao && npm run test:api && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:lab:unit: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix judge-worker
scripts.dev: concurrently -c blue,green -n api,web "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev:full: concurrently -c blue,green,cyan,magenta,yellow,red,white -n legacy-api,web,gateway,course,homework,lab,judge "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix api-gateway" "npm run dev --prefix course-service" "npm run dev --prefix homework-grade-service" "npm run dev --prefix lab-practice-service" "npm run dev --prefix judge-worker"
